rules.summary: Dark mode toggles that persist theme overrides in localStorage and toggle root .dark classes or data-theme attributes should update <meta name="color-scheme"> ("light dark", "light", "dark") paired with CSS color-scheme and light-dark().

keepWhen: JavaScript implements a user-facing dark/light theme override stored in localStorage and applies it by toggling a .dark/.dark-theme class or data-theme attribute on documentElement/body without updating <meta name="color-scheme">.
dropWhen: The code already updates <meta name="color-scheme"> content ("light dark", "light", "dark").
The code only reads matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)") without a user toggle or localStorage override (covered by dark-mode).
The code switches multi-brand or syntax-editor color palettes (e.g. Monaco/Ace editor themes) rather than light/dark page color scheme.

findings.message: Dark mode toggle persists theme state in localStorage and sets dataset.theme on the root element without updating <meta name="color-scheme">; synchronize <meta name="color-scheme"> with CSS color-scheme and light-dark().
